Appraiser remarks
The front bumper cover is cracked across the center and the grille support has bent
inward, with the radiator core support showing a clean fracture near the left mount.
Both headlamp assemblies are broken, and the hood latch and left fender edge show crush
consistent with a frontal strike at low speed. The repair plan calls for replacing the
bumper cover, grille, headlamp units, and hood latch, straightening the core support,
and refinishing the affected panels. The labor hours requested match the scope of this
damage. The shop's invoices list each part and operation once, with no duplicate
charges. Nothing in the vehicle history or owner statement suggests earlier damage to
these areas.
